asr.full_text: This is Shah and Dogecoin is sitting at one of the most important levels right now where the next move can be fast and aggressive and if you understand this structure properly you can stay ahead of the majority of traders the current price is around 0.091 and if you remember our last update we clearly marked this exact level as a key support zone and the market respected it perfectly. Price came down, held the support and bounced cleanly from it. That bounce pushed Dogecoin toward the resistance around $0.095 which was our marked level. Everything played out according to the plan. But once price reached that resistance, it faced rejection and dropped back down again. Now, here is where things get very interesting. PRICE is once again sitting on the same support level and it has already tested it multiple times. We are even seeing WIXs dropping slightly below the support but every time buyers step in and push price back up. This shows that there is still demand at this level and it is being defended actively. Now let me ask you something do you see this repeated holding of support as strength or do you think the level is getting weaker with every test. Because both perspectives exist and understanding this difference is what separates smart traders from emotional ones. of what's there on the net. A great question. One question can't be answered here. I think it is important, to be honest, to understand the importance of it. Because what that means for the market is that what is happening is not happening to the market itself, but rather to the value of itself. I think for our market, we also need to understand that the value of our stock, is for our future future, and this is just the one more point I would like to add. every time price comes back to the same support it absorbs more buying power the bounces are not pushing significantly higher and that creates pressure. And when pressure builds on a level it usually leads to a breakout or a breakdown not endless sideways movement. Right now as long as Dogecoin and continues to hold above this 0.091 support, the structure remains valid and the direction leans towards the upside. That means we can expect another move towards the resistance at 0.095, If price reaches there again that becomes the key level to watch, a clean breakout above that resistance with strong candles can shift momentum quickly and and once that breakout happens, the next target comes into play around 0.103. That is where price can move if buyers take control and momentum builds. However, you cannot ignore the downside scenario if this support finally breaks, especially after being tested so many times, the move down can be sharp. Strong supports, when broken, often lead to aggressive drops because many traders place their stop losses around these levels. Once those stops get triggered, it adds fuel to the downside. In that case, Dogecoin can move quickly toward the 0.080 area which is the next major support on the chart. Join shaa.com for free signals and let me know which coin you want me to cover next.
